title: Application Insights
description: Azure Application Insights is an Application Performance Management (APM) service. It collects telemetry data like requests, exceptions, dependencies, and custom events.

data.text: Azure Application Insights is an APM service that automatically collects telemetry from your .NET application. It tracks requests, exceptions, dependencies, page views, and custom events, then visualizes them in the Azure portal.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install the Application Insights SDK for ASP.NET Core.

data.title: Enabling Application Insights
data.content: Add the connection string in Program.cs and track a custom event.

terms.definition: Data automatically collected from your application, such as requests, exceptions, traces, and custom events.
A unique identifier that tells your app which Application Insights resource to send data to.
The main class used to manually track custom events, metrics, and traces.

data.title: Connection Strings
data.text: Newer Azure resources use a connection string instead of an instrumentation key. Always store this in appsettings.json or Azure Key Vault, never in source code.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Application Insights automatically collects request and exception telemetry
Use TelemetryClient to track custom events and metrics
The Azure portal provides dashboards, search, and alerting
data.takeaway: Application Insights gives you deep visibility into production behavior with minimal setup.

data.title: Exercise: Track Custom Events
data.description: Instrument an API with Application Insights custom events.
steps: Create an ASP.NET Core Web API project
Add the Application Insights connection string in appsettings.json
Inject TelemetryClient into a controller and track a custom event when an order is created
Run the API, make a request, and view the event in the Azure portal
data.expectedOutcome: Application Insights captures the custom event along with associated request telemetry.
